description: Updates wait as checkboxes on the Dependency Dashboard: ticking one creates the branch and the PR together, and the PR merges itself once the required checks pass. `platformAutomerge` hands the merge to GitHub's auto-merge, which waits only for the ruleset's required checks, so it is safe only while every CI job is required there.
`minimumReleaseAge` holds a new release for a week before it is proposed.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: `chore` commits cut no release, so a `chore(deps):` security fix would reach the published image only with some unrelated release. `fix` makes a security update a patch release on its own. These skip dashboard approval, so `automerge: false` keeps a person in front of every merge.

packageRules.description: Major updates may need code changes; merge them by hand.

Constraints are open `>=`, so the default strategy would propose nothing and upgrades would only arrive unattributed inside lock file maintenance; `update-lockfile` makes them named PRs touching `uv.lock`. No soak: `uv lock --upgrade-package` takes no version and resolves the newest release anyway, so a soak would only make the run fail.
New releases can add diagnostics with no source change; keep them out of the general group so a red check is attributable.
Renovate reports no release date for a digest update, so the soak would stay pending forever instead of holding anything back; the SHA pin and reading the diff are the guard.
Keep mise.toml and .python-version on one version. `matchPackageNames` matches packageName: mise's entry resolves to `python/cpython`.
Keep mise.toml and the container base image on one uv version.
